text:
mira: dropped a quick iterate for model-catalog compare + filters: https://redwood.design/figma/catalog-compare-v5 — pls quick review (focus: filters, pin, badges).

sam: nice! first thought: make the filter chips wrap and add a saved-presets dropdown.

oliver: agree on chips. Pin action needs to be one-click on the row, not hidden in kebab. small toast with undo is fine.

neha: badges: avoid color-only signals. show an icon + short label like 'P50 32ms' and full label on hover. ensure contrast passes a11y.

pat: table density: use two-line rows when badges present. on mobile switch to select-then-compare modal for up to 3 models.

mira: API note: front-end expects p50_ms, p95_ms, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_1k_cents, memory_bytes, quant_label — will confirm with backend.

sam: sorting: offer weighted-sort builder (small modal) so users can combine latency vs cost.

oliver: accessibility: add role=grid, aria-sort, aria-colindex, and keyboard arrows to navigate cells. focus reveals sparklines in an aside panel.

neha: copy: 'Pin version' vs 'Lock serving version' — maybe contextual. enterprise users get 'Lock', others see 'Pin'.

pat: edgecase: pinned version retired -> show 'Pinned (retired)' and suggest replacements. add migration CTA.

ux-bot: reminder: new tokens used in mock must be published. Open PR: https://git.redwood.ai/design-system/pulls/228.

mira: action items: 1) update figma with sticky filters + row pin + icon+label badges, 2) add aria + keyboard nav spec, 3) mobile compare modal, 4) link API fields. i'll ping when done.

sam: :thumbsup:

neha: will run quick a11y pass once mock updated.

pat: sounds good, thanks.
